milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Target is the center of the west wall (entrance face) at (4, 2, 8). Max distance 6 ensures the player must walk closer from spawn (~9.2 blocks away at origin) rather than being satisfied immediately. Facing tolerance 60 degrees ensures intentional observation of the stone brick wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Target is the closest magenta glass window on the north wall at (7, 2, 2). Max distance 5 requires the player to walk around the building corner from the entrance side to clearly see and face the glass windows. Facing tolerance 60 ensures they are looking toward the window.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The purple wall banner is at (4, 3, 8) on the west wall facing west toward the approaching player. Max distance 5 requires the player to be close to the entrance doorway. Facing tolerance 60 ensures they are looking toward the banner above the door. Banner placement confirmed successful in sandbox using purple_wall_banner[facing=west] syntax.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the available rule types don't include container-open detection. The shulker box is at (10, 0, 8) inside the building. Max distance 3 ensures the player has entered the building and is within Minecraft's interaction range (~4.5 blocks), strongly implying intentional interaction. Facing tolerance 45 (tighter than default) ensures they are directly looking at the box on the floor, which is necessary to right-click/open it.
